title: 第8章
content_zh: 第八章 城南交警中队新书需要票票支持，求票求收藏！萧凛虽然好奇那黑色洋装女子到底是来历，不过却没有无聊到跟着她上的出租车去调查，既然她已经明明白白说清楚了，萧凛也不可能热脸去贴冷屁股。不过说不后悔那是假话，想想那黑色洋装女子绝美的脸蛋，傲人的双峰，纤细的小手，圆滚滚的美臀，修长的双腿，只是在当时那样的情况下，萧凛已经没有了情欲，在自己的原则底线上，也不允许发生。萧凛回到住处的时候已经是凌晨一点半了，洗了澡，又东想西想，直到三点多才入睡，直接导致第二天早上快八点才起床。看着手机里的时间，萧凛不由得苦笑，刚进新单位就连续两天上班迟到，恐怕也就只有自己做得出来了，想着自己心爱的QQ车还在交通局，萧凛索性打了个电话给李静宜，说是今天有点事情要处理，加上要找房子之类的，向校医院请了假。李静宜能不答应吗？昨天人家萧医生才把科室主任的位置让给了她，今天处理点事情难道不能请假？只是看着办公室外面那十几个排队的学生，苦笑着对萧凛说道：“萧医生，今天来急诊的病患并不比昨天少，你办完事情尽快回来吧！”“嗯，我尽量！”萧凛回答道。李静宜挂了电话之后，想了想，把小宁叫过来，然后小声的说道：“小宁，等下你跟小周她们聊天的时候，要不经意的把萧医生今天请假不来上班传出去，要不然，今天我们就有得忙了！”这些来看病的学生，大部分是因为萧凛而来的，也许，萧凛不在这里上班的话，这一大早的，估计半个病人都没有。十多分钟后，便看到之前排队等在外面的那些女学生，有两三个走了，后面陆陆续续的来，陆陆续续的走，这些大都是冲着萧凛医生来的。校医院发生的琐事，萧凛自然不知道，此时正在打电话联系华清逸华公子，但是萧凛打了三通电话，对方都显示关机状态，萧凛这才敲了敲自己的脑袋：“华公子可不是一般的上班族，这个点，应该还在睡觉，我都快睡糊涂了！”新的生活方式，让萧凛很不习惯，不过幸好已经慢慢的溶入了。萧凛吸取了昨天的教训，上下班时间是道路最繁忙的时段，为了不让华清逸的宝马被拖吊去交警中队，萧凛在房子附近的街道早餐店吃了早餐，然后回去看了一会书，快要到十点的时候，这才向城南交警中队驶去。虽然萧凛不曾去过城南交警中队，不过华清逸的车子上有最新的卫星定位系统，倒是不难找到位置，不过路上的交通依然有点点堵塞，这让萧凛相当无语，难道自己不适合在燕京开车？怎么每次开车都会有点小状况，还是燕京的路况实在是惨不忍睹呢？萧凛从城东接近郊区的地方到达了城南交警中队，看了看时间，已经十点半了，虽然知道华清逸这个点还没有睡醒，但是萧凛认为自己已经很厚道的多给了他两个多小时的睡眠时间，这个时候打扰他，萧凛没有心理负担了。手机响了将近一分钟才接通，先是从手机里面传来了打哈欠的声音，才传过来华大少那懒洋洋的声音：“哥，这么早就起来啦！”得，这小子还在睡梦中，都还没清醒过来。萧凛嘴角边微微抽笑，以前咋不觉得这样的生活那么的操蛋呢？这都快十一点了，还没睡醒，道：“我现在在城南交警中队，我拿了车，你的车怎么办？丢在这里？”华清逸倒是有点无语，道：“哥，你把车放在城南交警中队就行了，我下午再过去取！”“……我靠，这小子太不地道了！”萧凛心中腹诽着，哥哥大清早的爬起来，他还在女人的肚皮上潇洒，嘴上却笑着说道：“小华，你确定不过来了？那你车子要是丢了，可别怪我！”华清逸总算听出点什么来了，整个人也清醒过来了，而这时候从手机里传出了女人的声音：“华少，这才几点，谁这么早打电话给你？”随后就听到华少道：“别，我哥的电话呢，一边去！”口气有点凶，那女人哼哼两声，倒是不敢违背华清逸的意愿。“哥，我马上过去，马上过去，您等着啊！”华清逸连忙对着手机说着，华清逸绝对有理由相信，自己的车子会丢，那可是五百多万的车子啊，开了一年都不到。“好，我等你！”萧凛微微一笑，这小子果然还在女人的肚皮上，连忙把电话挂了，生怕听到一些少儿不宜的声音。放下手机，萧凛开着车子进入了交警中队的大院里，看门的倒是没有为难萧凛，毕竟能够开得起这样车子的，非富即贵，岂是他们这些底层人员可以抗拒的，尤其是在这种地方上班的人，眼色不是一般的好。萧凛停车的地方是交警中队内部的停车位置，由于这辆车子太高档，知道这车主非富即贵，也就没人来过问，要是换作其他很普通的代步车，估计就不会这么风平浪静了。当然，萧凛从车上下来之后，他那一身不超过五百块的装扮，在旁人眼里，绝对是名牌货色。一辆车子从外面开进来，想要停在萧凛的车子旁边的车位上，这时候却看到一个四十来岁模样的中年大叔不知道从哪个角落冒了出来，不屑的对那辆车摆摆手，车主停下来，摇下车窗：“大哥，什么事！”“这里是单位停车的地方，不允许私人车停！”中年大叔义正言辞的说道。“那他为什么停？”车住是一个二十七八岁的青年男子，此时很不服气的指向正好从车里面走出来的萧凛。“一辆破蓝鸟，跟人家的宝马比！”这就是典型的狗眼看人低了。那位青年男子气归气，不过在这种地方也不敢咋样，自己可是来这里交罚单的，神气不起来，只得悻悻的走了。萧凛听见了那两人的对话，倒是有点无语，想了想，向那名中年男子走过去，那男子看到萧凛向他走过来，连忙换了一副嘴脸，笑嘻嘻的看向萧凛。“这位大哥，被拖吊的车子去哪里办理手续啊？”萧凛询问道。“在大厅那边，你进去直接去柜台询问就行了！”中男子指着交警中队的办公大楼说道，那态度，相当的和蔼啊，要不是萧凛之前看过他跟另外那个人说过话，还以为这大叔一直这么热诚和蔼呢。“谢了啊！”萧凛对这名中年男子并无好感，却也没有什么恶感，一句谢谢是必须的。“不客气，有什么不懂就来问我，交警中队的事情很少有我不知道的！”中年大叔笑容越发灿烂了。萧凛微笑的点点头，便不再搭理那中年男子，直接向交警中队的办公大楼走过去。城南交警中队的业务算是挺繁忙的，大厅上至少有三十个人在排着队办理业务，萧凛向一个三十岁上下的青年男子打听了一下，这个时候来办理手续的，大都是来缴纳各种罚单的。“对了，这位大哥，拖吊的车子去哪里办理手续啊？”萧凛问道。“小兄弟，摩托车被拖吊了？这可是很少见啊！”那名青年男子笑了笑道：“拖吊的车子一般是去二楼的事故科办理手续，”青年男子看萧凛也就二十出头的小伙子，而且穿着很普通，就是一普通市民的穿着，能够拥有一辆摩托车算是不错了。“谢谢了！”萧凛很有礼貌的说道，至于对方说自己过来拿摩托车的，萧凛也没有反驳。二楼比一楼冷清了不少，不像一楼是对外办理业务的大厅，二楼大都是办公室形式的存在，不时有一两个穿着警服从过道里过。萧凛左右看了看，刚才楼下那青年男子说的事故科在右边的走道上，萧凛信步走过去，只见事故科里面还站着两三个人，办公室里穿着警服的只有一男一女。“警官，能不能不吊销的我驾驶证？我就是靠这个吃饭的！”一名男子愁眉苦脸的说道。“出了这么大的车祸，你觉得吊销你半年的驾驶证很过分吗？”那名男交警面色不悦的说道。听到那男交警这么说，萧凛心理咯噔一下，等下自己不会也是这个待遇吧？小妞你别玩得太过啊。萧凛正在忐忑的想着，之前在办公室的那几个人已经走了，就剩下萧凛一个外人，那名女交警一早注意到了萧凛，时不时的盯着萧凛看，脸上露出了笑容。“小帅哥，来这里有什么事情要办的吗？”女交警二十三四的模样，想来是刚参加工作一两年，还停留在半花痴的状态。萧凛走上前去，一面拿出昨天那女警留下的单据一面道：“我的车子被你们交警队的人拖吊，现在我是来拿车的！”那女交警一脸花痴的接过萧凛手中的单据，还向萧凛眨了眨眼睛，道：“年轻人开车不要太快，摩托车所发生的车祸相对于小车来说，是比较多的！”然后瞄了一眼收据上的单号，倒是一愣，然后看向男交警，把收据给男交警一看。“先生，请你三天后再来办理手续！”男交警瞄了一眼那收据，对萧凛说道。
content_en: Chapter 8 The new book of the Chengnan Traffic Police Squadron needs votes to support it. Please vote and collect it! Although Xiao Lin was curious about the origin of the woman in the black dress, he was not bored enough to follow the taxi she got into to investigate. Since she had made it clear, Xiao Lin could not put a hot face on a cold butt. But it would be a lie to say that she has no regrets. Think about the beautiful face of the woman in the black dress, the proud breasts, the slender hands, the round buttocks, and the slender legs. However, under the circumstances at that time, Xiao Lin no longer had any desire, and based on his own bottom line, he would not allow it to happen. It was already half past one in the morning when Xiao Lin returned to his residence. He took a shower and thought about other things. He didn't fall asleep until about three o'clock, which directly led to him not getting up until almost eight o'clock the next morning. Looking at the time on his phone, Xiao Lin couldn't help but smile bitterly. He was late for work two days in a row when he entered the new unit. I'm afraid he was the only one who could do it. Thinking that his beloved QQ car was still at the transportation bureau, Xiao Lin simply called Li Jingyi and said that he had some things to deal with today and that he needed to find a house, so he asked for leave from the school hospital. Can Li Jingyi refuse to agree? Dr. Xiao just gave her the position of department director yesterday. Can't she take leave to deal with some things today? Just looking at the dozen students lining up outside the office, he smiled bitterly and said to Xiao Lin: "Doctor Xiao, the number of patients coming to the emergency department today is no less than yesterday. You should come back as soon as possible after finishing your work!" "Well, I will try my best!" Xiao Lin replied. After Li Jingyi hung up the phone, she thought for a while, called Xiao Ning over, and then whispered: "Xiao Ning, when you chat with Xiao Zhou and the others, you should inadvertently spread the word that Dr. Xiao will take leave today and not come to work, otherwise, we will be very busy today!" Most of these students who came to see the doctor came because of Xiao Lin. Maybe, if Xiao Lin didn't work here, there wouldn't be half a patient this early in the morning. More than ten minutes later, I saw two or three of the female students who had been waiting in line outside left, and then came and left one after another. Most of them came for Dr. Xiao Lin. Naturally, Xiao Lin didn't know about the trivial matters that happened in the school hospital. She was on the phone to contact Mr. Hua Qing Yihua at this time, but Xiao Lin made three calls and the other party showed that the phone was turned off. Xiao Lin then knocked on his head: "Mr. Hua is not an ordinary office worker. At this point, he should still be sleeping. I am almost falling asleep!" Xiao Lin is not used to the new lifestyle, but fortunately, he has slowly integrated into it. Xiao Lin learned the lesson from yesterday. Commute time is the busiest time on the road. In order to prevent Hua Qingyi's BMW from being towed to the traffic police squadron, Xiao Lin had breakfast at a street breakfast shop near the house, then went back and read for a while. It was almost ten o'clock before driving to the traffic police squadron in the south of the city. Although Xiao Lin has never been to the Chengnan Traffic Police Squadron, Hua Qingyi's car has the latest satellite positioning system, so it is not difficult to find the location. However, the traffic on the road is still a bit congested, which makes Xiao Lin quite speechless. Isn't it suitable for him to drive in Yanjing? Why do I always get into trouble every time I drive, or is the road condition in Yanjing really terrible? Xiao Lin arrived at the traffic police squadron in the south of the city from the east of the city near the suburbs. He looked at the time and saw that it was already half past ten. Although he knew that Hua Qingyi had not woken up at this time, Xiao Lin thought that he had been kind enough to give him more than two hours of sleep. Xiao Lin had no psychological burden for disturbing him at this time. The phone rang for nearly a minute before it was connected. First there was the sound of yawning from the phone, and then Young Master Hua's lazy voice came over: "Brother, you got up so early!" Well, this kid was still asleep and hadn't woken up yet. Xiao Lin smiled slightly at the corner of his mouth. Why didn't he think this kind of life was so fucked up before? It was almost eleven o'clock, and he still hadn't woken up. He said, "I'm at the Chengnan Traffic Police Squadron now. I took the car. What should I do with your car? Leave it here?" Hua Qingyi was a little speechless and said, "Brother, you leave the car at the Chengnan Traffic Police Station." Just go to the squadron, I'll go pick it up in the afternoon! ""... Damn, this guy is so unreasonable!" Xiao Lin cursed in his heart. His brother got up early in the morning, and he was still on the woman's belly, but he said with a smile: "Xiaohua, are you sure you can't come here? Then don't blame me if your car is lost!" Hua Qingyi finally heard something and woke up. At this time, a woman's voice came from the mobile phone: "Master Hua, what time is it, who called you so early?" Then he heard Master Hua say: "No, where is my brother's phone, go away!" The tone was a bit fierce, and the woman hummed twice, but she did not dare to go against Hua Qingyi's wishes. "Brother, I'll be there right away, I'll be there right away, just wait!" Hua Qingyi hurriedly spoke to his cell phone. Hua Qingyi definitely had reason to believe that his car would be lost. It was a car worth more than 5 million yuan, and it had been driven for less than a year. "Okay, I'll wait for you!" Xiao Lin smiled slightly. As expected, the boy was still on the woman's belly. He quickly hung up the phone, fearing that he would hear some inappropriate sounds for children. Putting down his mobile phone, Xiao Lin drove into the compound of the traffic police squadron. The gatekeeper did not embarrass Xiao Lin. After all, those who could afford to drive such a car were either rich or noble. How could lower-level people like them resist? Especially those who work in such a place, their eyes are not generally good. The place where Xiao Lin parked his car was the parking space inside the traffic police squadron. Because the car was too high-end, and knowing that the owner of the car was either rich or noble, no one came to ask. If it had been replaced by another ordinary scooter, it probably would not have been so peaceful. Of course, after Xiao Lin got off the car, his outfit, which cost no more than 500 yuan, was definitely a famous brand in the eyes of others. a car
